title: Expensify vs FullStory: Employee expense management or digital experience analytics and session replay?
description: A decision guide for Expensify versus FullStory. Expensify focuses on employee expense management; FullStory focuses on digital experience analytics and session replay. Compare the actual job, workflow, and operating requirements rather than assuming a single winner. Check current vendor documentation and plan terms before deciding.

verdict: There is no verified universal winner between Expensify and FullStory: they focus on employee expense management and digital experience analytics and session replay, respectively. Start with the outcome your team needs, then pilot the product that directly supports that outcome. If both jobs are required, assess whether the tools complement one another and define ownership at the handoff. Verify current features, plan limits, total cost, integrations, privacy, permissions, and support before committing.

faqs.question: What is the main difference between Expensify and FullStory?
faqs.answer: Expensify focuses on employee expense management; FullStory focuses on digital experience analytics and session replay. They should not be compared as interchangeable products unless your required workflow shows a genuine overlap.

faqs.question: Can Expensify replace FullStory?
faqs.answer: Only if a pilot proves that Expensify meets the requirements you currently depend on FullStory to satisfy. Check required outputs, permissions, integrations, and operational controls before switching.

faqs.question: Can a team use Expensify and FullStory together?
faqs.answer: Potentially, if the team needs both employee expense management and digital experience analytics and session replay. Define which product owns each step, how information moves between them, and who is responsible for access and data quality.

faqs.question: How should I compare their costs?
faqs.answer: Estimate the cost of the specific workflow you need: include seats, usage, integrations, setup, support, and ongoing administration for Expensify and FullStory. Verify current vendor pricing and plan limits rather than relying on old figures.

faqs.question: What should I test before choosing?
faqs.answer: For Expensify, test whether it handles employee expense management with acceptable setup and ongoing effort. For FullStory, test whether it handles digital experience analytics and session replay. Compare both against written success criteria and review security, privacy, and support requirements.
